title: Caribbean perils
text:
Caribbean perils

The following table lists the perils and peril codes that 
Touchstone
 supports for the Caribbean.

| Import peril code | Peril | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PAL | All licensed perils | |
| PES | Earthquake shake only | |
| PPH | Precipitation flood | |
| PWA | All wind perils (tropical cyclone and severe storm) | Winter storm sub-peril is valid for U.S. exposures only. |
| PTS | Tsunami | |
| PWH | Tropical cyclone only | |
